name: Interwerks
summary: Sydney dialup + corporate access + hosting ISP (Interwerks Pty Ltd, ~2000); defunct (ACN 097 460 270).

events.details: Defunct. ISP retail homepage archived into Dec 2021 with final captures Feb 2022 then total silence and an unreachable domain today — c. 2021-22 as proposed (the ABN died in 2015 while the site mouldered on).

refs.label: Full retail ISP homepage live 3 Mar 2021 (2021-02-23 identical, revisit 8 Dec 2021); ADSL2/broadband/bundles pages and broadband appform PDFs still 200 during J
Final Wayback trace of the domain is 19 Feb 2022; site is unreachable in 2026.
Company ABN actually cancelled Oct 2015 — the frozen ISP site outlived the registered company by years (page frozen since Feb 2012).
